query: Arm Holdings fiscal year end date and fiscal quarters
normalized: arm date end fiscal holdings quarters year

output.content:
Arm Holdings’ fiscal year ends on **March 31**; for example, its FY2025 annual report covers the year ended March 31, 2025. [[1]] 

Its fiscal quarters are calendar-based as follows: 
- **Q1:** April 1–June 30 
- **Q2:** July 1–September 30 
- **Q3:** October 1–December 31 
- **Q4:** January 1–March 31 [[2]] [[1]] 

For example, Arm identified its fiscal Q2 FY2026 as the quarter ended September 30, 2025, while its fiscal-year-end results correspond to the year ending March 31. [[2]] [[3]]

sources.title: Arm Holdings plc Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements
